name: Bisaakir Zaari
body:
The Bisaakir Zaari, those who serve genies or demons, intervene between the people of the Dry Lands and the powerful genies of their world. These spellcasters pursue a unique path of enlightenment, communication and, ultimately, power. By linking themselves irreversibly with the powers of the elemental planes, bisaakir zaari place their fate in the hands of the most capricious and powerful beings known to the Dry Lands, in hopes of in some way influencing them and bringing good fortune to their people.

Bisaakir Zaari are chosen for their powerful personalities and personal ambition. No genie wants to be allied with a weak-willed, unambitious mortal, as this will do little for its own advancement. The genie makes its desires know to a bisaakir in many little ways, growing more impatient as the days pass if its wishes are not acknowledged. Some very strong-willed bisaakir court the genies in their territory, hoping to attract attention and gain an ally. While most people are uncomfortable with those who deal with the supernatural, and the uncertain favor of the genies, the desert mages are practical and recognize the benefit of having someone with the ear of the djinn.

Role: When a bisaakir zaari and her genie’s wishes align, there is little that can stop them. Together, they can control the flow of battle, or decimate enemies with the right combination of spells drawn from the genie’s planar realm.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d6.

Parent Classes: Oracle and witch.

Starting Wealth: 3d6 × 10 gp (average 105 gp). In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the bisaakir zaari.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Bisaakir zaari are proficient with all simple weapons. They are not proficient with any type of armor or shield. Armor interferes with the bisaakir’s gestures, which can cause her spells with somatic components to fail.

Spellcasting

A bisaakir zaari casts arcane spells drawn from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. The bisaakir must choose and prepare her spells ahead of time.

To learn or cast a spell, a bisaakir zaari must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell level. The Difficulty Class for a saving throw against a bisaakir zaari’s spell is: 10 + the spell level + the bisaakir’s Charisma modifier

A bisaakir zaari can cast only a certain number of spells of each spell level per day. Her base daily spell allotment is given on Table: Bisaakir Zaari. In addition, she receives bonus spells per day if she has a high Charisma score.

A bisaakir zaari may know any number of spells. She must choose and prepare her spells ahead of time by getting 8 hours of sleep and spending 1 hour communing with her genie. While communing, the bisaakir decides which spells to prepare.

Cantrips: Bisaakir zaari can prepare a number of cantrips, or 0-level spells, each day, as noted on Table: Bisaakir Zaari under “Spells per Day.” These spells are cast like any other spell, but they are not expended when cast and may be used again.

Cantrips prepared using other spell slots, due to metamagic feats for example, are expended normally.

At 3rd level, and every odd level thereafter, the bisaakir adds her chosen mystery’s bonus spells to the spells granted by her genie. She can prepare those spells normally as bisaakir zaari spells. If she reins in her genie’s power (see below), she can also direct her genie to cast those spells.

Renegotiation

At 5th, 10th, and 15th level, a bisaakir zaari must renegotiate her genie’s contract, granting it more freedom in exchange for the greater power it offers her. At 5th level, the bisaakir gains the Improved Familiar feat and applies it to her genie. She still gains the benefits associated with her genie’s original form, and can still change those benefits once per day as a free action.

At 10th level, the genie can cast elemental shape III on itself once per day, but only to become an elemental of its same type (an ifrit becomes a fire elemental, and so on). At 15th level, it can also cast elemental shape IV on itself once per day. The genie uses the bisaakir’s level as its effective caster level with these spells.

If a bisaakir fails to uphold her contract, either by keeping it locked away or continually refusing its demands, her genie places an oracle’s curse of its choice upon her until she makes a deal with another genie or begins to uphold the contract they agreed upon. While the curse is in effect, the genie gains none of the added benefits listed here, and the bisaakir gains all benefits and penalties of the applied curse.

Genie (Su)

Bisaakir zaari draw power from genies; elemental beings capable of great magic, but unable to utilize it fully outside of their realm. This relationship is mutually beneficial because it grants the bisaakir access to spells and allows the genie to explore other planes of reality. But the genies’ magic requires more than a taste of freedom; the bisaakir must satisfy their genie’s requests with subservience, payment, or sacrifice.

Contract (Ex)

At 1st level, choose an oracle mystery that becomes associated with the bisaakir’s genie. Once this choice is made, it can’t be changed without making a deal with a different genie, thereby breaking any deals made with the previous one. The bisaakir gains the chosen mystery’s class skills at 1st level.

At 1st level, the influence a genie has over the bisaakir is small, which allows the genie to take the form of a tiny elemental animal. This functions as the witch’s familiar ability, except the bisaakir can ask her genie to change its form once per day as a free action to gain a different bonus.

A bisaakir zaari must commune with her genie each day to prepare her spells. Her genie grants the bisaakir all of the spells that she knows, and a bisaakir zaari cannot prepare a spell that is not granted by her genie. A bisaakir zaari’s genie begins play granting her all of the 0-level sorcerer/wizard spells plus three 1st level spells of the bisaakir’s choice. The bisaakir also selects a number of additional 1st-level spells equal to her Charisma modifier that her genie grants her. At each new bisaakir zaari level, she adds two new spells of any spell level or levels that she can cast (based on her new level) that are granted by her genie.

A bisaakir zaari can also gain additional spells from her genie by performing favors or meeting its demands and performing a special ritual akin to a witch adding new spells to her familiar.

At 2nd level, and again at 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th level, a bisaakir zaari chooses either to rein in her genie’s power or accept a gift in exchange for payment.

Gift (Ex or Su)

The bisaakir gains a revelation from her contract’s mystery each time she selects this option.

Rein In (Sp)

As long as a bisaakir zaari’s genie is within 10 feet of her, she can direct the genie to cast one spell it grants her without preparing it or using one of her spell slots. The spell the genie casts must be at least two spell levels lower than the highest spell the bisaakir can cast (minimum 1st). She can do this once per day for each time she selects this option. Each time her genie casts a spell in this way, the spell’s level must be one lower than the previous limit. For example, at 18th level, Ronari can direct her genie to cast one 7th-level spell, one 6th, one 5th, one 4th, and one 3rd.

Phenomenal Power

At 20th level, a bisaakir zaari can gain an at will spell-like ability or a final gift granted by her genie.

Final Gift (Ex or Su)

The bisaakir’s genie grants her the final revelation from its associated mystery.

Spell-Like Ability (Sp)

Choose one 4th-level or lower spell granted by the bisaakir’s genie. The bisaakir can cast that spell at will as a spell-like ability, even when her genie isn’t present. If the spell is normally lower than 4th level, the bisaakir can grant it the benefits of one metamagic feat, even if she doesn’t know that feat, to bring it up to 4th level.

Favored Class Bonuses
Drakorin: Add +1/4 natural armor bonus to the AC of the bisaakir’s genie.
Elf: The bisaakir’s genie grants her one additional spell. This spell must be at least one level below the highest spell level the bisaakir can cast. If the bisaakir ever replaces this genie, the new genie grants these bonus spells.
Gnoll: Add +1/6 to the bisaakir’s level for the purpose of determining the effects of one of her genie’s gifts.
Human: The bisaakir’s genie can cast elemental shape on itself +1/6 times per day. That spell’s level must be at least one level below the highest spell level the bisaakir can cast (minimum 4th).
